msg: there are two pairs of gnomes. the greyish and white color ones usually give out the most yield from a scale of 1-9. However, when you see the yield decreases for the grey and white gnome, select the opposite colors. They will yield a lot but not as frequently as the other colors. Once you feel like the purple and the other colorful gnome start to not yield more a lot, go back to the greyish/white color ones which are more frequent in yielding alot. Switching should occur when you start to see 1-2 yields for that particular color.
